final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(address_count) AS average_count FROM city_counts), matched_average AS (SELECT cc.city_id, cc.address_count, cc.address_count * 1.0 / ac.average_count AS count_over_average FROM city_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN avg_count AS ac WHERE ac.average_count IS NOT NULL), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(address_count) AS total_count FROM matched_average), matched_total AS (SELECT ma.city_id, ma.address_count, ma.count_over_average, ma.address_count * 1.0 / tc.total_count AS count_over_total FROM matched_average AS ma CROSS JOIN total_count AS tc WHERE tc.total_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT city_id, address_count, count_over_average, count_over_total FROM matched_total ORDER BY count_over_total IS NULL, count_over_total DESC LIMIT 10
